description: This Java source file defines the ReferralOrder class, which extends ServiceOrder, adding referral-specific attributes and behaviors. It includes methods for copying, cloning for discontinuation, and revision, indicating it manages referral order lifecycle operations within the OpenMRS framework.

classes.name: ReferralOrder
classes.description: A subclass of ServiceOrder that adds referral-specific attributes and methods, supporting cloning and lifecycle operations.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of this ReferralOrder instance.
